note: Numbers are append-only. Never renumber or reuse a number; retire an entry with "retired": true and take next_number for new entries. stack = most per inventory slot. kind: material, tool, weapon, placeable. Numbers in 'tool' and 'weapon' are placeholders until skills exist. look_alikes feed inspection mode. durability = uses a tool lasts; wear is kept per inventory slot (server-owned). repair = materials one repair spends; a repair wins back half the durability. value = price of one item in COPPER (data/items/coins.json: 10 copper = 1 bronze, 10 bronze = 1 silver, 10 silver = 1 gold) (inventory sort; items without one count as 2). description: one plain line shown in the tooltip (job 75).
